name: Error-Driven 2D Gaussian Training
definition: A densification strategy that samples and optimizes 2D Gaussian kernels in image space using a differentiable rasterizer, then back-projects them to 3D. It uses pre-rendered images as fixed backgrounds.
summary: Error-Driven 2D Gaussian Training optimizes 2D Gaussian kernels in image space to initialize 3D Gaussians, distinguishing itself by optimizing in 2D rather than directly manipulating 3D primitives.
